In this video, we dive deep into Spark execution planning — understanding how Spark converts your code into optimized execution stages before running it.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
What you’ll learn:
How Spark creates Unresolved Logical Plans
What is a Resolved Logical Plan and how Spark uses the catalog
The role of Catalyst Optimizer and its rule-based optimizations
How Spark generates Physical Plans and compares them
Understanding the Cost Model used to pick the best plan
